description: Normative Agent Delegation 1.0 test vectors. Every principal document marked valid MUST pass principal document validation (Sections 4 and 5.1) and every document marked invalid MUST be rejected; delegation IDs and audiences MUST be accepted and rejected as listed; and every acceptance case MUST produce its expected outcome. Controller registration challenge shapes, request shapes, and proof signatures MUST produce the listed validity outcomes; owner authorization, binding, and expiry remain provider checks in Section 4.3.

principal_documents.name: delegation service is a URL, not an origin

acceptance.description: Evaluate each case against document, resolved at its own id. live cases apply acceptance (Section 7) at accepted_at; historical cases verify an accepted record { envelope, accepted_at } (Section 6). previous is the credential before the event. expected is ok or the error code.
